rules: Activity effects depend on context and character preferences rather than fixed universal rewards.
A socially positive activity may be tiring rather than restorative for some characters.
Study can advance learning while also consuming time/recovery capacity.
Emergency duty may be professionally necessary while increasing short-term load.
Consensual intimacy may contribute to connection/recovery in a positive context but is never modeled as a fixed morale reward.
No activity instantly cancels long-term accumulated strain.
